title: The hull's deploy is an fx module (src/fx/hull-deploy.js); the deploy let leaves the controller
context: Refactor round 2 (plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-13-refactor-round-2.md, Task 7). DEPLOY, the one way a hull enters the world (at rest in its berth, driven out in manual, an authored roll-out playing its clip, the hung-deploy watch), was about ninety controller lines around the let `deploy`, which was read or written at twenty-odd sites: the CTL state line, the drive camera's blend, the shield's frozen check, the hull's visibility (three sites), the frame (pilot cancels, the step), five hosts' deploy getters, two setDeploy setters (the first hull's issue, the key probe), the acceptance state and two adapters. deployStart, deployFramePoseFor and deployProgress are held as values by host literals above the region (the diag overlay at 1240, the hull loss at 3630, the boot probes).
outcome: src/fx/hull-deploy.js createHullDeploy(host) holds the region as it was, every comment with it, `deploy` its own state, and returns { active, clip, state, set, cancel, start, step, framePoseFor, progress, ease }. Host: player, params, shots, poseCamera, arriveAt, paintThrottle as values; stopEngine: (fade, quiet) => engineAudio.stop(fade, quiet), lazy (the engine is made later); getters for berths, graph, lifeContainers, story, playerMesh, speedBonus, cellSide, cellIndex, deployCount; setters for deployCount (deployCount++ becomes setDeployCount(deployCount() + 1)), throttle, cruise, autoMode, playerDown. td-tab keeps deployStart, deployFramePoseFor and deployProgress as hoisted one-liners; the sites read hullDeploy.state() / clip() / active() / ease(), write hullDeploy.cancel() / set(v), and the frame and the hull host step through hullDeploy.step. The deploy-path imports leave td-tab. td-tab 5,899 -> 5,839 lines. No behaviour change.
alternatives: Keep `deploy` in td-tab and move only the functions: rejected, the functions write it and the module would need a getter and setter for its own state.
Rewrite the deployStart call sites (seven) to hullDeploy.start: rejected, two host literals above the region hold it as a value, so the hoisted one-liner stays and the sites stay unchanged.
evidence: Side-by-side proof (scratch harness, not committed): the ORIGINAL region (td-tab 3635-3721 at 2701edd3) through new Function under `with` beside the module over the same fakes (a 40-cell sphere graph, four berths of both shapes, bays with and without roll-outs, the real src/domain/deploy-path.js), 200 seeded scenarios x 600 operations (start of valid and invalid berths, steps including dt 0 and 3 s, poses, reads of active/progress/ease/clip, cancel, set(null), speed 0, the bonus, the cell size, a held/unheld/absent story hull, the graph missing, the mesh): 157,992 log entries (camera poses, arrivals, paint and engine calls, bay rolls, the hung warnings and shots.hung, the thrown errors' messages when the graph is missing, and after every operation the deploy, the player, the count, the lever, cruise, auto, playerDown, the mesh's visibility and the bays) equal; two mutants (a held hull leaving the player up, the roll-out framing's rolled test inverted) caught.

node test/hull-deploy.mjs: nothing starts without a berth or a graph; start puts the hull at rest in the berth (free mode and virtual start off, manual, lever at zero, the engine stopped quietly) and counts; travelled grows by params.speed * speedBonus * cellSide * 1.6 * dt along the run with an eased progress; the hull arrives at the exit cell and hands over; a held hull is parked with the player down; an authored roll-out hides our hull and rolls the bay on the deploy's clock, once; a speedless deploy is handed over at 6.5 s with the SHOTWATCH line; a deploy whose berth is gone is dropped.

tools/refactor/undef-diff.mjs: no new undefined or unused names; comments-kept.mjs: every comment word kept; tdz-check at the call: none in the dead zone; node test/host-contracts.mjs: hold for 57 factories.
npm test 259 programs; npm run check (5839 lines under 6400, the long-line budget held); npm run build.

Browser suites from snapshot t7-deploy-002139 (tools/refactor/suites.sh): --opening, --seats, --sectors pass; --defense fails at 'no unpiloted tower kill' and --story at 'twelve landmarks at stage 8', the same steps and values as the untouched base's battery; --probe passes mobile-input (the key probe clears the deploy through setDeploy; its 15 LAYOUT/KEYPROBE lines identical to the base snapshot's) and fails at shell-explosion as the base does.
